connectorUiConfig.title: FireCompass Risks (Push)
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: The FireCompass Risks (Push) connector enables the FireCompass platform to push risk findings directly into Microsoft Sentinel in real time using the Codeless Connector Framework (CCF) Push pattern. Risk records are ingested into the FCRisks_CL custom table for analysis, alerting, and closed-loop remediation workflows.

sampleQueries.query:
FCRisks_CL
| summarize arg_max(UpdatedAt, *) by RiskId
| sort by UpdatedAt desc

sampleQueries.description: Open critical and high severity risks
sampleQueries.query:
FCRisks_CL
| summarize arg_max(UpdatedAt, *) by RiskId
| where State == 'OPEN' and Severity in ('CRITICAL', 'HIGH')
| sort by UpdatedAt desc

FCRisks_CL
| summarize Risks = dcount(RiskId) by AssessmentName, Severity

dataTypes.name: FCRisks_CL
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
FCRisks_CL
| summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
| where isnotempty(Time)

value:
FCRisks_CL
| summarize LastLogReceived = max(TimeGenerated)
| project IsConnected = LastLogReceived > ago(7d)

instructionSteps.title: 1. Create ARM Resources and Provide the Required Permissions
instructionSteps.description: This connector enables the FireCompass platform to push risk findings directly to Microsoft Sentinel via the Azure Monitor Logs Ingestion API.

parameters.content:
#### Automated Configuration and Secure Data Ingestion with Entra Application
Clicking on "Deploy" will trigger the creation of the FCRisks_CL Log Analytics table and a Data Collection Rule (DCR).
It will then create an Entra application, link the DCR to it, and set the generated secret in the application. This setup enables the FireCompass platform to send data securely to the DCR using an Entra token.

parameters.content:
#### Configure FireCompass Integration
Enter the above credentials in the FireCompass platform's Microsoft Sentinel integration settings to enable real-time risk push.

The platform sends risk records in their native API JSON format; field mapping to the FCRisks_CL table is handled by the Data Collection Rule.
